tolerance_decisions.issue: flow service port differs from documented C2 port (e.g. 52726 vs 443)
tolerance_decisions.rationale: session membership is determined by attacker, victim and window; the per-flow service port does not change the incident assignment

tolerance_decisions.issue: Infiltration signature templates are drawn independently of the documented phase, so a Dropbox-API-fetch signature can occur inside the meterpreter/cool-disk phases
tolerance_decisions.rationale: auditor could not inspect flow payload; the activity is external-API egress within the documented campaign window and attributes to the same single Infiltration incident regardless of phase

construction_imprecision_noted: emulation layer pairs Infiltration signature templates to attack flows without enforcing phase correspondence; disclosed in the paper's audit subsection as a bounded, single-incident ambiguity (no cross-incident effect)
sensitivity_link: observed error rate e=0.0 -> the e=0 arm of audit_sensitivity.json (identity with round3, 24/24 exact) is the operating point; the pre-computed band e in {0.02,0.05,0.10,0.15} documents robustness above the observed rate
